who.value: seller who just hosted a Live show

job.value: Pack the right items and see how the show did

arrivedFrom.value: Ending the show or opening it from My Shows

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Show summary' with 'Total earnings S$2,403.00', lots sold and an Orders list says it plainly.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: There is no primary action; 'Go to Lot #' is a small grey field and the stats take the top third, so the packing job has no clear starting point.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Tabs 'Orders / Performance / Clips', filter chips and 'Go to Lot #' predict what they show.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'UNSOLD', 'UNPAID', 'Lots' and 'Buy Now items' are the seller's own vocabulary.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller only filters or searches, using lot numbers they know.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Every row prints a full 'Order ID: O181d7792-e59e-…' UUID that a packer rarely needs up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Stats and the order list both serve the post-show moment.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The rows are scannable but the long order IDs on each one add text to read past.
